howItWorksSteps.title: Sign up
howItWorksSteps.description: Email, password, done. 90 seconds. 7-day free trial with full features.

howItWorksSteps.title: Import your past
howItWorksSteps.description: Drag-and-drop your Google Takeout zip, OwnTracks records, GPX files, or any of 15+ formats. Watch your history reconstruct itself on a map.

howItWorksSteps.title: Track forward
howItWorksSteps.description: Install the iOS or Android app. Background tracking starts automatically. Trips, heatmaps, and stats update in real time.

painSection.heading: Your location data is in one of three places right now.
painSection.p: None of them put you in charge.
painSection.p2: Feeding ad targeting for a decade. Timeline now stranded on your phone, with no cloud backup going forward.
painSection.p3: Sold as “aggregated insights” to advertisers. Read [The Markup’s reporting](https://themarkup.org/privacy/2022/01/27/life360-said-it-stopped-selling-precise-location-data-but-the-data-still-flows) if you doubt it.
painSection.p4: Because every privacy-respecting alternative wanted you to learn Docker first. So you never started.

differentiators.heading: What actually makes Dawarich different
differentiators.p: Hosting and backups are table stakes. Here’s what isn’t.
differentiators.p2: Hosted on Hetzner in Germany. No US transfers. No PRISM, no Patriot Act, no “we cooperate with US authorities” footnote.
differentiators.p3: The full Dawarich engine is on [GitHub](https://github.com/Freika/dawarich) with OVER 9,000 stars. If we ever shut down, you self-host the same software with one command and import your exported data.
differentiators.p4: Most competitors only ingest their own data. We ingest everyone’s — Google, Strava, Garmin, Apple Health, OwnTracks, and a dozen more.
differentiators.p5: Strava knows your runs. Polarsteps knows your trips. We know everywhere you’ve been.
differentiators.p6: Heatmaps, Fog of War, Globe view, automatic trip detection, year-in-review. Not just a dot on a map.
differentiators.p7: Connect Immich or PhotoPrism — your photos appear on the map next to where you took them.

competitorReframe.heading: Why pay for what Google “gave away” for free?
competitorReframe.p: Free wasn’t free. You paid in data — every coffee shop, every Sunday hike, every late-night drive — fed into Google’s profile of you.
competitorReframe.th4: What they do with your data
competitorReframe.td4: Trained ad targeting for a decade
competitorReframe.td12: Full lifetime history, heatmaps, trips, stats
competitorReframe.text: We charge less than Life360 charges to

promises.heading: The “you can’t lose” promise
promises.p: “Trust us with your location data” is a big ask. So here’s ours:
promises.p2: Full features for a week. Cancel from Subscription Settings if it’s not for you — your exports stay yours.
promises.p3: No annual lock-in penalty, no exit fees, no “are you sure?” emails.
promises.p4: Every byte of your data, exportable in GPX, GeoJSON, KML, or raw JSON, on any plan, forever.
promises.p5: If Dawarich Cloud ever shuts down, you self-host the same software and import your exported data. **We literally cannot hold your data hostage.**

cloudFinalCTA.heading: Stop renting your memories from companies that don’t care.
cloudFinalCTA.p: Your location history is the map of your life. The places you fell in love. The trip you took the year your mom got sick. The route you used to bike to your first job.
cloudFinalCTA.span: 7-day free trial · Cancel anytime · Or [self-host the open-source version](https://github.com/Freika/dawarich) if you’d rather. We support both. We always will.
